questions.question: What is the basic requirement for applying for a UK driving licence?

analyses.content: 录音明确指出，不管你有没有其他国家的驾照，想获得英国驾照的首要条件是你必须是英国居民（UK resident），对应选项C。
你可能听到了medical report，但那是更新驾照（renewed）时的要求，而不是申请驾照（applying）的基本要求，读题要注意动作阶段。

If you have never had a driver's license, or you have one from another country and you want to get a UK license, you must be a UK resident. You will need to show a medical report when your UK license needs to be renewed.

questions.question: What is true about the translation of original licences?

analyses.content: 录音提到翻译驾照必须去官方机构（official agency），这直接对应选项A中的认可机构（recognised organisation）。
你可能会因为听到费用而想选C，但录音说明服务费已经包含在驾照费里了（included in your license fee），不需要交额外费用，同时录音也强调了翻译是必须的（a must），排除了B。

If you are trying to translate your original foreign driving license to apply for a UK license, which is a must if you want to be able to drive here, you will need to visit an official agency. These are scattered throughout the London area and are well-equipped to assist you with any questions you might have, and any services they offer are included in your license fee.

questions.question: When applying for a UK licence, which type of photos will NOT be approved?

analyses.content: 录音中明确说明大部分被拒绝（rejected）的照片是使用了奶油色背景（cream backdrop）的照片，直接对应选项B。
你可能会选A或C，但录音明确说照片太小（too small）可以用打印机放大，戴眼镜（wearing glasses）也是被允许的（still allowed），读题时一定要注意问的是哪个“不被”批准。

When you are getting a new driving license, you may need to have a new photo taken, as some photos are rejected. It's actually okay if your photo is too small, since we can get it enlarged with our printer. The majority of rejected photos are the ones that were taken with a cream backdrop instead of a monotone gray background. We've now found that photos with the latter allow us to identify the license holder much more easily. If you were wearing glasses on the previous photo, you don't need to worry about it since it is still allowed.

questions.question: What does the speaker think of the license checking service?

analyses.content: 说话人提到希望这个流程能更快一点（going faster），因为要花好几个小时，说明他觉得目前流程太慢了，对应选项A。
你可能会因为听到“procedures are quite clear”被带偏，但这恰恰排除了B选项的“confusing”，一定要往后听到他抱怨“速度慢”的真实态度才能成功避坑。

If you are not sure whether your previous license is still valid, then the license checking service is for you. The procedures are quite clear, and you just have to follow them. Ideally, I would like to see the process going faster since it can take hours to finish.

questions.question: What does the speaker recommend about making an application?

analyses.content: 说话人给出的唯一建议是，最快的申请方式是在网上（on the Internet）填表，这完美对应选项C。
你可能会纠结去哪个网点办理，但录音中他明确表示网点忙闲程度取决于你在哪，可以随便选（take your pick），并没有推荐具体的地点，所以A和B都是干扰信息。

I'm often asked whether I have a personal recommendation about the fastest or cheapest place to get all this done, but I think it really depends on where you are. They can all get busy at some point, and when it is quiet at one branch, it may be busy in another. So take your pick. All I would say is that there is absolutely no difference in price. It's a standard fee. The only advice I would give is that the quickest way to complete an application is to fill out the form on the Internet and then bring a print copy with you to the agency location of your choice.

analyses.content: 说话人总结伦敦交通时，强调交通标志非常清晰（traffic signs are very clear），这与选项A的good signage是直接的同义替换。
你可能会一听到单行道（one-way systems）就急着选E，但说话人紧接着用“But”进行了转折，强调了整体而言标志很清晰，一定要听完转折后的核心态度。
London is obviously the biggest and busiest, and there are lots of parking restrictions, one-way systems, and so on. But on the whole, I find the traffic signs are very clear.
提到爱丁堡时，录音明确指出这里的红绿灯极其高效（traffic lights... extremely efficient），直接对应选项F。
你可能会听到步行区（pedestrian areas）想选H，但原文说是因为步行区人多，所以才凸显了红绿灯高效调控的重要性，这里的核心管理特征依然是红绿灯。

It is a city of lights, traffic lights, but they're extremely efficient as they're timed perfectly to get the traffic flowing smoothly. That's important because pedestrian areas and crossings are always packed with people on foot, which needs strong regulation.
录音明确指出卡迪夫完成了道路扩建，增加的额外车道（extra lanes）缓解了拥堵，直接对应选项G。
这道题的干扰较少，但如果你没反应过来extra lanes就是选项里“additional lanes（增加的车道）”的同义替换，可能会因为不敢选而漏听。
The city of Cardiff has tackled traffic flow in a different way. It recently completed a road expansion scheme, and the extra lanes of the dual carriageway are easing congestion.
录音中提到大多数曼彻斯特的车辆为了避免拥堵会选择走环路（ring roads），完美对应了选项D。
你可能会听到police can intervene就想选C，但录音强调那是未来可能引入的（possibility），而题目问的是“目前的特征”（current feature），时态干扰是最大陷阱。

It's a similar story in Manchester. Instead of going through the town center, most vehicles choose ring roads so as to avoid the downtown congestion. It can still happen though, so there's a possibility that the city will introduce checkpoints where the police can intervene to direct traffic at peak periods.
说话人提到牛津有很多进出城市的选择（many options for getting in and out / alternative routes），与选项B的多条通路（multiple access roads）直接挂钩。
你可能会因为听到“条条大路通罗马”的俚语而走神，做匹配题时需要快速抛弃废话，抓住紧随其后的实质性解释“many options”来锁定答案。
And finally, they say all roads lead to Rome, and you could say that about Oxford. I like the many options for getting in and out of the city because drivers can always find alternative routes.
